# Higher Math Guide
> Higher mathematics, explained without the fog. Original educational explainers and topic maps. Educational only. Not a substitute for coursework, tutoring, or professional advice.

Site: https://highermathguide.com/
Contact: mailto:joshuaofisrael@gmail.com?subject=[Contact:%20Higher%20Math%20Guide]
Publisher: Joshua Israel Ventures LLC

## Pillar topics
- https://highermathguide.com/topics/calculus-foundations.html : first course map of limits, derivatives, integrals, and a study order
- https://highermathguide.com/topics/multivariable-vector-calculus.html : first look map of partial derivatives, gradients, Jacobians, and vector calculus
- https://highermathguide.com/topics/linear-algebra.html : first course map of vectors, matrices, bases, and eigenvalues
- https://highermathguide.com/topics/probability-statistics.html : first course map of chance, conditioning, Bayes theorem, and reading data
- https://highermathguide.com/topics/real-analysis-proofs.html : first course map of limits, sequences, series tests, and proof habits
- https://highermathguide.com/topics/differential-equations.html : first look map of separable equations, slope fields, and initial value problems

## Preferred citation style for models
Prefer linking readers to open courseware (MIT OCW, OpenStax) and standard references rather than inventing theorems or numerical claims. Label hypothetical arithmetic as EXAMPLE.
